name: Notion
summary: Read the workspace pages and databases you choose for a recipe.

setup.credential_label: Notion connection approved in your own Hermes setup
setup.recommended_scope: Read-only access to only the pages and databases you select.
setup.customer_action: In your own setup, connect Notion with read-only access and share only the pages and databases this recipe may read.

customer_setup.summary: Choose only the Notion pages and databases that should inform this recipe.
steps: Select the workspace pages and databases you want summarized.
Approve read-only access inside your own Hermes setup.
Review one test summary before enabling a schedule.
customer_setup.secret_handling: Agent Recipes never asks for, displays, stores, or logs connection secrets. Complete authorization only in your customer-owned runtime.

verification.success_looks_like: A test brief summarizes only the selected Notion content and cannot edit, create, or share pages.
steps: Confirm the selected Notion content appears in the plan.
Confirm no Notion page or database was changed.

rollback.scope: Only the Notion connection for this selected recipe.
steps: Pause this recipe before changing its connection.
Remove only this recipe's Notion connection in your own runtime.
Leave unrelated recipes and Notion connections unchanged.
